title: Circular convolution bank
summary: A bank binds each symbol to its position by circular convolution and superposes the results; a probe unbinds by circular correlation through a fast transform.
core_idea: Bind symbols to positions by circular convolution and unbind by correlation.

state.name: gantrel
state.meaning: Superposed bank of circular convolutions of symbol and position codes.

update.name: step
update.latex: gantrel_t = gantrel_(t-1) + circular convolution(p_t, x_t) via fft
update.plain: gantrel_t = gantrel_(t-1) + circular convolution(p_t, x_t) via fft

learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.

prediction.statement: One bound pair is read back.

capabilities.prediction: Recalls the symbol at a position among 64 bound pairs.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: Circular binding is a known vector technique.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: Fixture only; no difference is claimed.

falsifiers: The bank norm is zero after a write.

toy_example.python:
import json
a = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
b = [0.0, 2.0, 0.0]
c = [sum(a[j] * b[(i - j) % 3] for j in range(3)) for i in range(3)]
print(json.dumps({'c1': c[1]}))
